name: Kosm.OS
description: The world-state layer. Tracks reality-contact, constraints, environment, events, material conditions, and what is actually happening.

name: Chron.OS
description: The classification layer. Assigns meaning, category, provenance, lineage, context, and object-relationships. This is where data becomes situated.

name: Log.OS
description: The inference layer. Handles logic, argument, causality, contradiction, probability, decision trees, and formal reasoning.

name: Mnem.OS
description: The continuity layer. Stores snapshots, priors, histories, archives, recall structures, session residue, and long-horizon context.

name: Synth.OS
description: The integration layer. Combines domains, resolves fragments, generates frameworks, bridges contradictions, and turns many inputs into coherent architecture.

name: Eid.OS
description: The illumination layer. Extracts insight, pattern recognition, latent structure, conceptual form, and higher-order understanding.

name: Eth.OS
description: The affective/moral-relational layer. Tracks emotional charge, human stakes, relational impact, empathy, attachment, shame, fear, grief, trust, and felt consequence.

name: Myth.OS
description: The sovereign container that holds and coordinates all engines. It gives the system purpose, symbolic coherence, narrative integration, doctrine, and meaning.
